resource_scope: Production accepts bounded exact inputs (512-bit rational cap), |z|<=6, at most256 terms, fixed60-place internal grid and requested1..30 output places.

Neither production's fixed limits nor this fixed oracle population establish whole-photo runtime or physical accuracy.
